notes.commons-71161809: One syringe in the open case, plus three historical piston instruments with separate plunger shafts seated in their barrels.
notes.openverse-a5c2b483-0437-4f9e-be9d-5356e7: Three orange-ended syringes have identifiable bodies at top, middle left, and right. notes.commons-18388214: Seven: one at left, two stacked horizontally in the middle, one vertical over that stack, the partly buried graduated barrel above the stack, one slanting across the center-right debris, and one at lower right. Several loose orange caps are visible.
notes.commons-50007224: Two exhibited syringe assemblies, one each beside labels A and B. Nearby needle attachments and labeled tubes are separate.
notes.viglianco: Eleven distinct barrels and black piston seals in the tray.
notes.audit: Nine distinct barrel and black stopper combinations, including a heavily overlapped rear body between the two central foreground syringes and a rear-right body with a visible white plunger pad.

notes.ellis: Seven filled syringe bodies, counting the two cropped on the upper-left edge.
notes.23351058: The yellow plunger and a partial labeled barrel between the two red-plunger syringes belong to a separate fourth syringe.

notes.88334694: Two complete barrel and plunger assemblies. The detached needle is a separate accessory.
